name: aws-flash-cards
description: Self-maintaining flashcard deck for the AI-native development domain. Numbers, prices, dates and region lists come from deterministic AWS sources, never from a model.
comment: Zero dependencies by design (NFR-1). TypeScript runs directly on Node's native type stripping — no bundler, no lockfile, no supply chain.

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm test && npm run build && npm run parity && npm run claims && npm run lifecycle && npm run rename
scripts.ingest: npm run ingest:regions && npm run ingest:pricing && npm run ingest:quotas && npm run ingest:api && npm run ingest:docs && npm run ingest:vendor
scripts.refresh: npm run ingest && npm run apply && npm run apply:rename && npm run build
scripts.ingest:docs: node src/ingest/docs-release-notes.ts && node src/ingest/docs-doc-history.ts && node src/ingest/docs-feature-regions.ts && node src/ingest/docs-pages.ts
scripts.ingest:vendor: npm run ingest:kiro && npm run ingest:releases
